gen-gf-bellota-gf-shippori-mincho-b1: Bellota's s throws its ends far away from the spine, and every stroke looks traced with a single stylus. Shippori Mincho B1 is the classic serif with sturdier hairlines.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-stix-two-text: Bellota draws everything with one width of stroke, a tracing-pen look with a wide-hanging s that grabs attention fast. STIX Two Text keeps its thinnest strokes weighty, so it grounds the page.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-tai-heritage-pro: Level, quiet, and oddly bold in outline. Bellota has an uninflected beat, while Tai Heritage Pro lays down modest contrast like lightly engraved brass, with a clear channel leading into each round letter. Bellota is best at making an entrance; the classic serif is best at settling in.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-taviraj: Taviraj reads like a bookish serif, with a generous gap where each curve ends and medium contrast throughout. And Bellota, with joins that never thin where strokes meet, earns its keep when set big and short.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-trirong: Bellota looks like glass tubing bent into letters, with an s whose ends hang far from the spine. And Trirong, a classic serif with softly varied strokes and gently flared curve ends, offers the quiet counterweight below.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-trocchi: Bellota cuts every line to a single width, like sign-shop vinyl, with an s whose ends hang far from the spine. Trocchi, a text serif with a middling thick-thin difference, can then take a size that suits long reading.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-trykker: Bellota keeps one constant stroke from top to baseline. Trykker, a classic serif, adds a light swelling in each rounded letter, and its open counters let long paragraphs breathe with a literary, refined tone.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-uchen: Uchen has lowercase curves that welcome the eye inside, with stems and hairlines in a close ratio that make the classic serif feel dignified. Bellota is best for its a without thin hairlines; Uchen is best at refined text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-vollkorn-sc: Vollkorn SC reads as a literary text serif, with medium contrast, terminals cut short of the bowl and loosely spaced tracking. But Bellota, flat and unswelling along every curve, earns its keep when set big and short.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-yuji-syuku: Yuji Syuku is a dignified text serif with open spacing between every glyph pair and a modest stem-to-hairline ratio. Bellota's pencil-sketched, never-pressing lines lead boldly, and the text face follows with quiet authority.
